resharper.noBuild: After successful compatible Release build and exact restored source

sourceLanesNotRepeated: Runtime unit/provider/integration/stress/native lanes are source-phase gates; product source and executable baselines are unchanged in this contract target.
resolvedValidationIssues: Two first-run temporary probe builds inherited repository warnings-as-errors because their disposable directory was inside the worktree. Empty temporary Directory.Build.props/targets/Packages.props restore external-probe isolation without weakening real source builds.

The initial contract lacked registration for its nine overlapping MODIFIED owners. The exact source-pinned proposed-owner validator now binds all hashes, requires canonical/source tasks open and keeps approval null; no global registry or old approval changed.
A probe-report script expected the full untruncated hash in assertion output. The actual wrong-hash guard assertion was correctly red; its semantic failure signal was checked instead.
reviewClarifications: Original reference is scoped to the actual business-step body/returned error, not DI construction, codecs or other non-step boundaries.
Per-instance settlement must be observed outside that same instance's still-owned body/callback; arbitrary application wait-cycle detection is not promised.
A failed unaccepted start has no settlement handle. External/step ownership or a completed host join remains necessary for resource release.
approvalBoundary: Self-review and green process checks confer no canonical/source/push/issue-change authority.
